scope: Miao Chapter 18 (pp. 587-614): the basic DMP model (matching, Nash bargaining, job creation, steady state existence and uniqueness, comparative statics, the Beveridge curve, transitional dynamics, large firms, efficiency and the Hosios condition), endogenous job destruction (reservation productivity, steady state, comparative statics, saddle path), unemployment in a business-cycle model, and Exercises 1-5.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 18
